## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`

Scope: skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs
Security-touching: no

Read: cards #34444 and #34450 (bodies, triage and claim comments), PR #34484 (body, four files, the one claim comment), the net diff from merge-base `e8cba8fe` to the head (three commits), the head's check-runs, and the cited engine code on `origin/main` (`24b6ae55`). Nothing between the merge-base and `main` touches `skills/objectstack-formula/**`, `packages/formula/**` or the ratchet script, so the head's claims are judged against the same engine either way.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`label(record.f)` over a multi-select — right.** The row now says: each selected label, in stored order, joined with `, `; `''` for null or an empty selection. On `main`, `optionLabelOf` (`packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts`) hands a list value to `labelEachOption`, which is `values.map(labelOf).join(', ')`: stored order, separator comma plus space, an empty list reads `''`, null reads `''`. The reader's locale comes from the pinned `optionLabels` map, as for a single select. Pinned by `packages/objectql/src/engine-formula-option-label.test.ts` (a `select` with `multiple: true`).
- **`timestamp()` over a `date` field is refused — right.** `firstDateTextCall` (`packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts`, the #34363 arm) finds a one-argument `timestamp(...)` call whose argument is a field typed `date` (the `dateOnly` set built in `validate.ts` from `fieldTypes[name] === 'date'`), at any depth, so the `+ duration(…)` form is found too. `dateTextCallIssue` returns it at severity `error` under code `date-text-call` for a formula. A `datetime` field is not asked, and the skill names the `date` field only.
- **`isoDate(addDays(record.d, n))` — right.** `addDays(dyn, dyn)` coerces date text through `toDate` (UTC parse of `YYYY-MM-DD`), shifts on the UTC calendar and returns a Timestamp; `isoDate(Timestamp)` renders the first ten characters of the UTC ISO text. No host-timezone dependence. It is the `shift` clause the refusal itself prints, and `validate-date-text-arithmetic.test.ts` and `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts` pin that this spelling validates clean and evaluates (`+7` over `2026-11-16` reads `2026-11-23`).
- **Three deletions — right, no teaching lost** (see ④ d).
- **Token ceiling 5997 to 6008 — right** (see ④ d).
- No accept-set or public code surface changes: no schema, no validator, no engine file is in the diff.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/34444-formula-skill-multiselect-label-timestamp-date.md` declares `@objectstack/skills: patch`. The diff publishes skill wording and two eval fixtures for behaviour already shipped; patch is the right level. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` stand on the PR body and on the changeset, and agree: nothing here narrows or widens what a consumer may author. `Check Changeset` is green.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Open questions: neither card nor the PR body leaves one open. The claim's line budget (net +4 lines on the SKILL.md, one eval per card) is met: +1 line, two evals.
- Tier flag: the claim and the PR body say the diff was authored at `TIER_DEFAULT` under the low-headroom exit with an at-tier contract review as the compensating control. This record is that review.
- Check-runs on the head: 46 runs, none red: 30 `success`, 16 `skipped`, none pending. Green among them: `Lint & Repo Gates` (the token ratchet's home), `Check Changeset`, `PR-body guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Build Core` and the `Test Core` aggregate.
- SQL push-down: n/a. No hunk teaches or adds a query, an id materialisation or an in-app join.

### ④ Design judgment

**(a) `label()` row, tried against edge cases.** A value no option declares reads as stored, per entry (`oneOptionLabel`); the row does not say so for either the single or the multi case, and says nothing false. A null entry inside a list reads `''`; an object entry throws. A cleared multi-select is stored as null (`field.zod.ts`, the `multiple` describe), which the row's "null or an empty selection" covers on both stored shapes. The untouched tail of the row (formula fields only, a predicate faults) still holds: the macro's evaluate throws without an `optionLabels` map.

**(b) `timestamp()` sentence, tried against edge cases.** The refusal fires at authoring time, in `validateExpression`, which `os validate`, `os build` and the save door run; "the build refuses it" is the wording the neighbouring date-text callout already uses. In a predicate the code carries an outcome arm (`date-text-call-fail-closed` and siblings); the skill gives the family name, as the existing callout does. `timestamp(record.d + 'T00:00:00Z')` is not refused and does evaluate, which agrees with "parses only a full ISO instant". The new sentence and the existing callout ("wrap it in `date()` first") do not contradict: `addDays` takes the text as it is, `isoDate` does not. On a null date the taught formula faults at `isoDate` and the field reads null; that is the engine's own prescribed rewrite and is unchanged by this PR.

**(c) Evals 11 and 12.** Each expected output satisfies its own assertions. Id 11: an answer that builds a field per option, a ternary chain, or a hand join through `joinNonEmpty` (a real stdlib function, so a plausible wrong path) fails. Id 12: the cloud#4717 shape `timestamp(record.borrow_date) + duration('168h')` fails on both `must_contain` and `must_not_contain`; a bare `addDays(...)` (a Timestamp, where text was asked) fails `must_contain`. Both prompts test the taught behaviour.

**(d) Paydown and ratchet.** Each cut sentence keeps a home in the same file at the head:
- the `has()` paragraph's null-check sentence: the cheat-sheet `Null check` row, "`!= null` is the whole guard" two sentences on, the gate paragraph's `!= null` / `== null` / `!isBlank()` list, and the `isBlank(v)` row;
- "`shared/expression.zod.ts` declares both surfaces and their carriers": the Core contract paragraph, the table's `Carriers` column directly above, and See also;
- "on update and delete events it is bound per matched row": the §5 `previous` table's `after*`, `before*` and bulk-update rows; the note keeps its `(§5)` pointer and its insert-event warning whole.
No remaining sentence refers to a removed one, and nothing left reads differently for the cut.

The ratchet's own rule for a raise (header, "The ratchet discipline"): deletion of restatement in the same file shown in the diff, the standing ruling quoted in the body, the row moved by the measured remainder and pinned at the measurement. All four hold. Blob sizes: 23972 bytes at the merge-base and on `main`, 24050 at the head; the stamp line is 20 bytes on both; priced 23952 (5988 tokens, headroom 9 under 5997) and 24030, and `ceil(24030 / 4)` is 6008. Net +78 bytes equals the stated 321 added minus 243 cut. The row comment's arithmetic matches. No eval path gained a ceiling row.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract; left as accepted deviations):
- N1 (nit) — eval 12's `must_contain` accepts one spelling only. `isoDate(addDays(date(record.borrow_date), 7))` is also correct and would fail, and so would a right answer that quotes the refused `timestamp(record.borrow_date)` as a warning. Same grader pattern as the existing id 10.
- N2 (nit) — card #34444's body lists "a value no option declares reads as stored" in passing; the row does not carry it. The docs page does, and the row never taught it for a single select either.
- N3 (nit) — the row names `multiple: true` only. The engine answers any list value, so an inherently multi option type that declares options reads the same way.
